player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ka bɔ Checkers ka ɲɛ {color}.
Kɛɲɛ kɔnɔ cɛsiri-style notation [fileRank fileRank], nɔgɔ. '[b2c3]' (kɔlɔn kɔrɔ a–h, kɔlɔn kɔrɔ 0–7).
Kulunsi kɔrɔ:
  • Ɔ bɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin kɔrɔ 1 ɲɔgɔn ɲɛ.
  • Ɔ bɔ kɛɲɛ kɔnɔ dɔɔnin ɲɛgɛn kɔrɔ.
  • Ɔ bɔ dɔɔnin kɛɲɛ kɔrɔ ɲɛ ɲɛgɛn kɔrɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A be se ka ca a la, ka [a1b2], oyo [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Funteni tɛ yen bilenman bolo. Nɛgɛtigɛlanw bɛ se!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Funteni tɛ yen bilen na. Kɔrɛnin bɛ se sɔrɔ!
